# Original synthetic MIDI fixture

`arrangement-single.mid` is MNEMOBARD-authored synthetic test data, generated by
`scripts/arrangement-fixtures.mjs` from `tests/support/arrangement-fixtures.ts`.
It contains a conductor, one lane and one note, including explicit trailing silence.
The generator checks existing bytes and refuses to replace changed evidence.
Independent validation uses the Python standard-library reader `scripts/verify-midi.py`.
No legacy or personal musical material is included.
